correct_translation: He came after you left.

correct_translation: I will wait till you have written the letter.

correct_translation: The paint on the seat on which you are sitting is still wet.

correct_translation: This is all you have to do now.

correct_translation: If you don't go, I won't, either.

correct_translation: You don't have to go unless you want to.

correct_translation: I don't care as long as you are happy.

correct_translation: What you have said applies only to single women.

correct_translation: What you said surprised me.

correct_translation: Whatever you may say, I won't give it up.

correct_translation: The picture you are looking at is a copy of a Picasso.
